description:
Activate Woodland Weavemaster by tapping it, adding an amount of {G/W} equal to its power that can only be spent to activate abilities of Elves or to cast Elf spells.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Woodland Weavemaster and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat, alternating between adding {G} and {W} each loop as needed.
